result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I'd recommend **Dropbox Sign** for straightforward contract signing, or **DocuSign** if you want the most widely recognised platform.

However, the best choice depends on how many documents you send, how many staff need access, and whether you need more than just signatures.

Here are my top picks for 2026.

## Best e-signature software for small businesses

![PandaDoc Review: Sign, Seal, Deliver](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/0MUKV24vOJ8Fy84anuzrEeDfSf0kpDjVQFizvzFH_No27CWsxijbo2OMMlOGpvgS85vZB3wg04yrL3uUEA8HfUdyjeWSSz3aH8VUzmHL1gINYfR2lzt9WJR1seELOV2zEpePqA9WPggyXDEs9xtNtG6ptm3fJ7rmZx4q6N4W7fYpmzjZfQx9dTipSbsTdrj3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best overall for simplicity)

- Easy to send contracts and collect signatures.
- Clean, straightforward interface.
- Good templates and signing workflows.
- Paid plans offer unlimited signature requests.

Best for: Small businesses wanting hassle-free signing.

[Website and pricing](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![AlignedPartner - Partner Program Consulting](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6SBWynbkn-bwRkCuMIHuBO284Y100e0fDpdUDFLZztrUUgkyW1-tpHcC5kTOqtjz5KB_xBScAISRTstaI0F65z5jXu0N46he4NZBZ6WfWk96sgJLpvvT2RrcS-xO0hh1EvFzwRy6VbJduS4ruy6JYed3q5wUxhQz8NAeUe2M3V1pVOdebhqoA5Ko-m3kjQ5x?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign**

(Best established platform)

- Widely recognised by customers and businesses.
- Strong audit trails and security features.
- Extensive integrations with other business software.
- Good for more complex approval processes.

Best for: Businesses signing contracts regularly with customers, suppliers and partners.

[Website and pricing](https://www.docusign.com/)

---

![PandaDoc Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/opy__qKCrCsIKnnF5NHqBYNkFSD9tFJxhM39aLVUKpNw8OxuNc3sSNOdGSyNGxaqIKKrmce4TuaVLmGO9eSbwlpx_ArOoLhxrlRmtBC9tAc0Mt_Es7zHktC9aUhmHT5EUOLg6P9MGqBrXjzTrjD1lx16SP7BAihCSKTMGiqzFSlJl3OCCns1gQY78yXl07V_?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PandaDoc**

(Best for sales and proposals)

- Create professional quotes and proposals.
- Add pricing tables and payment options.
- Track when customers open documents.
- Collect signatures in the same workflow.

Best for: Businesses sending quotes, proposals and service agreements.

[Website and pricing](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![Best e-signature software | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/wmbNwQd5sZcCQM_y8xDHl0CPe7pgdwCT-krxdtJ31tc_1PKqy7PiBHAl_-Gd913WdMSfKG4tvcbm87CrehlVzyh0S_XfsJoy8bGchL0mjaA3hnz0pBJgnLcUXZcQanS1poRpGWtqsda_EXu0W3Y1sz9Tm8p7il83hsR4mOfYqnnCRPXfp1UL4Ot3PT4uhG1W?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. signNow**

(Best budget option)

- Good core e-signature functionality.
- Reusable templates.
- Document routing and multiple signers.
- Competitive pricing for small teams.

Best for: Businesses wanting practical signing features without paying for a premium brand.

[Website and pricing](https://www.signnow.com/)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Logo Wordmark PNG Vector - BrandLogo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/95na-wLQUN9p7GmfVbVlsMH9WIm3-bHOmsuOzR4w7FH_LNHajHgaUKajbYSFfuQalq9gsQjPtmcFPYYjJQoXKBtI8uyMeQC8oBjmdwkaHvf0cQn2ZgYIR22CA9JGfELZMa-MGbcgzYfhWePcbsbIj2Mlr0RTRu05Ww7rIP3mtZmaOkamqppjBubOBDVYwJ7W?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

- Excellent PDF editing and signing capabilities.
- Useful document management features.
- Integrates with Adobe Acrobat and other business tools.

Best for: Businesses already working heavily with PDFs.

[Website and pricing](https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/business/sign.html)

## Quick comparison

| Software | Best feature | Approx. entry pricing\* |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Dropbox Sign | Simple signing | US\$15/month |
| DocuSign | Business credibility | US\$11/month |
| PandaDoc | Quotes and proposals | Free / US\$19 per user/month |
| signNow | Value for money | US\$8/month |
| Adobe Sign | PDF management | US\$16.99/month |


\*Indicative advertised starting prices from 2026 comparisons, generally USD and often based on annual billing. Actual Australian pricing, GST and plan limits may differ. [helpcompare.com](https://helpcompare.com/e-signature/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[serpastra.com](https://serpastra.com/blog/best-e-signature-software-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[dupple.com](https://dupple.com/learn/best-e-signature-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Important if you're operating in Australia

Electronic signatures are generally legally recognised in Australia under applicable electronic transactions legislation.

Before choosing a platform, look for\:

- An audit trail showing who signed and when.
- Timestamped signing records.
- Signer authentication.
- Secure document storage.
- Downloadable copies of completed agreements.

Some document types and transactions have additional requirements or exceptions. [www.ag.gov.au](https://www.ag.gov.au/legal-system/electronic-signatures-documents-and-transactions?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.ag.gov.au](https://www.ag.gov.au/legal-system/electronic-signatures-documents-and-transactions/electronic-signatures?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down to Dropbox Sign, DocuSign and PandaDoc.

But I can make a much more specific recommendation with one question\:

**What type of small business are you running?**

For example, professional services, construction, consulting, real estate, retail, or something else?

That will help me identify the best option for your contracts, customer agreements, staff paperwork and day-to-day signing needs.

search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
